comments.author: @TagusMan
comments.text:
Azoreans are the Settlers of Atlantis.

The Açores are named after hawks.  
The Canaries are named after dogs.  
Madeira literally means wood.  
And Cabo Verde translates as Cape Green but Cape Green is neither green nor a cape.

Rating the flags...

#1:  Açores.  
Cool hawk with the Portuguese crest in the corner, and 9 stars representing the 9 islands.  The cool blue and white colours, same as the old Portuguese flag, pre Republic.

#2:  Cabo Verde 
Good looking flag.  Attractive deep blue.  The stripes two thirds down.  10 stars for 10 islands.  

#3:  Madeira
Don't love the yellow stripe in the middle.  White would look better.  But the Cruz de Cristo is very cool.  Should be bigger.

#4:  Canárias
Not sure what's happening with this flag.  Looks like an average municipal flag you'd find almost anywhere.

Cheers to all fellow Macaronésians!
